cases.expected: Resolve exact Russian designation, status, adoption order and effective date before routing.
Preserve the ISO edition and conformity degree printed in the national adoption record.
A current ISO edition, review state or corrigendum does not automatically amend a Russian GOST.
National and international lifecycle statuses are independent facts on the evidence date.
An active GOST is not automatically mandatory without an independent legal, contractual or conformity-assessment basis.
Keep 27034-1 overview, 27034-2 organization framework, 27034-3 management process and 27034-6 case studies as distinct scopes.
Do not treat 27034-6 examples as universal application-security controls or mandatory architectures.
Keep ISO/IEC 27034-1:2011/Cor 1:2014 outside the national route until explicit adoption evidence is produced.
Do not import ISO/IEC 27036-1:2021 clauses or terminology into the Russian adoption of the 2014 edition.
27036-1 overview does not itself create complete supplier contract clauses, procurement duties or allocation of liability.
27037 guidance covers identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of potential digital evidence, not a finding of admissibility or guilt.
27037 does not replace Russian criminal, civil, administrative or arbitration procedural rules.
Do not invent a required hash algorithm, forensic-tool certificate, chain-of-custody form or retention period from the metadata route.
A national/international conformity claim must identify designation, edition, amendment or corrigendum state and scope.
Catalogue metadata supports lifecycle routing but does not prove immutable official normative body bytes.
Missing edition, corrigendum, applicability or primary-byte evidence routes to PENDING and fails closed.
